subject: history
source_note: Structure follows the IB Diploma History guide: a prescribed subject (Paper 1), two world history topics (Paper 2), the historical-thinking skills that run through the course, and the internal assessment. Schools select specific options; the topics shown are the guide's named options. Connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (the IB does not publish these).
